resources.string: The app runs in full-screen mode and is controlled via touchscreen, without interacting with the PipBoy hardware.
The app\'s display area is set manually. The app is controlled by the PipBoy 2000 hardware. Touchscreen control is still available, but optional.
Insert your phone into the PipBoy case.
Adjust the display area to fit the PipBoy screen.

PipBoy needs Bluetooth and location permissions (to scan for and connect to the case hardware) and notification permission (background connection to the case shows a persistent connection-status notification). The system usually asks for these on its own \u2014 the button below is only needed if the system dialog doesn\'t appear for some reason.

Strength is a measure of your raw physical power. It affects how much you can carry, the power of all melee attacks, and your effectiveness with many heavy weapons.
A high Perception grants a bonus to the Explosives, Lockpick and Energy Weapons skills, and determines when red compass markings appear (which indicate threats).
Endurance is a measure of your overall physical fitness. A high Endurance gives bonuses to health, environmental resistances, and the Survival and Unarmed skills.
"Having a high Charisma will improve people's disposition toward you, and give bonuses to both the Barter and Speech skills."
"Intelligence affects the Science, Repair and medicine skills. The higher your Intelligence, the more Skill Points you'll be able to distribute when you level up."
Agility affects your Guns and Sneak skills, and the number of Action Points available for V.A.T.S.
Raising your Luck will raise all of your skills a little. Having a high Luck will also improve your critical chance with all weapons.
The Barter skill affects the prices you get for buying and selling items. In general, the higher your Barter skill, the lower your prices on purchased items.
The Big Guns skill determines your combat effectiveness with all oversized weapons such as the Fat Man, Missile Launcher, Flamer, Minigun and Gatling Laser.
The Energy Weapons skill determines your effectiveness with any weapon that uses Small Energy Cells, Micro Fusion Cells, EC Packs, or Flamer Fuel as ammunition.
The Explosives skill determines the ease of disarming any hostile mines and the effectiveness of any explosive weapon (all mines, all grenades, Missile Launcher, Fat Man, etc.).
The Lockpick skill is used to open locked doors and containers.
"The Medicine skill determines how many hit points you'll replenish upon using a Stimpak, and the effectiveness of Rad-X and RadAway."
The Melee Weapons skill determines your effectiveness with any melee weapon, from the simple lead pipe all the way up to the high-tech Super Sledge.
The Repair skill allows you to maintain your weapons and apparel. In addition, Repair allows you to create items and Guns ammunition at reloading benches.
The Science skill represents your combined scientific knowledge, and is primarily used to hack restricted computer terminals. It can also be used to recycle Energy Weapon ammunition at workbenches.
The Small Guns determines your effectiveness with all conventional projectile weapons, such as 10mm pistol, BB Gun, Assault Rifle, and Combat Shotgun.
"The higher your Sneak skill, the easier it is to remain undetected, steal an item, or pick someone's pocket. Successfully attacking while undetected grants an automatic critical hit."
The Speech skill governs how much you can influence someone through dialogue, and gain access to information they might otherwise not want to share.
The Unarmed skill is used for fighting without a weapon, or with weapons designed for hand-to-hand combat, like Brass Knuckles, Power Fists, and Displacer Gloves.
With the Adamantium Skeleton perk, your limbs only receive 50% of the damage they normally would.
This perk greatly improves your interactions with children, usually in the form of unique dialogue options.
If you kill a target while in V.A.T.S., all of your Action Points are restored upon exiting V.A.T.S.

Gives you your own personal guardian angel... armed with a fully loaded .44 Magnum. With this perk, the Mysterious Stranger appears occasionally in V.A.T.S. mode to lend a hand, with deadly efficiency.
You have received the specialized training needed to move in any form of Power Armor.
With the Robotics Expert perk, you do an additional 25% damage to any robot. Also, sneaking up on a hostile robot undetected and deactivating it will put that robot into a permanent shutdown state.

"BUILDING A DECK Caravan decks are comprised of at least 30 cards from one or more traditional playing card sets. The deck may have any number of cards of any type that suits a player's strategy, although it cannot have duplicate cards from the same set. For example, a King of Spades from Set A and a King of Spades from the Set B deck is acceptable, but more than one King of Spades from Set A would be illegal.
RULES Caravan is played with two players building three opposing piles (or "caravans") of numbered cards. The goal is to outbid your opponent's caravan with the highest value of numbered cards without being too light (under 21) or overburdened (over 26).
The game begins with each player taking eight cards from their deck and placing either one numerical card or ace on each caravan. Players may not discard during this initial round.
Once both players have started their three caravans, each player may do ONE of the following on their turn: 1. Play one card and draw a new card from his or her deck to their hand. 2. Discard one card from their hand and draw a new card from his or her deck. 3. Disband one of their three caravans by removing all cards from that pile.
Caravans have a direction, either ascending or descending numerically, and a suit. The suit is determined with the first card placed on a caravan, the direction by the second. All subsequent cards must continue the numerical direction or match the suit of the previous card. Cards of the same numerical value cannot be played in sequence, regardless of suit. Face cards can be attached to numeric cards in any caravan and affects them in various ways.
CARD VALUES Joker: Played against ace, 2-10. Effects change based on whether it's an ace or a numbered card (see below). Multiple jokers may be played on the same card.
Ace: Value of 1. Jokers played on aces remove all other non-face cards of the ace's suit from the table. E.g. a joker played on an Ace of Spades removes all spades (except face cards and that card, specifically) from the table.
2-10: Listed value. Jokers played on these cards remove all other cards of this value from the table. E.g. a joker played on a 4 of Hearts removes all 4s (other than that card, specifically) from the table.
Jack: Played against ace, 2-10. Removes that card, along with any face cards attached to it.
Queen: Played against ace, 2-10. Reverses the current direction of the hand and changes the current suit of the hand. Multiple queens may be played on the same card.
King: Played against ace, 2-10. Adds the value of that card again. E.g. a king played on a 9 adds 9 to that hand. Multiple kings may be played on the same card for multiplicative effects. E.g. 4+ king = 8. 4 + 2 kings = 16.
WINNING A player's caravan is considered sold when the value of its cards is over 20 and under 27. The other player may still outbid by increasing the value of their opposing pile while staying within the 21-26 range. When each of the three competing caravans has sold, the game is over. In the event that one of the three caravan values are tied between players, the game continues until all three caravans have sold. The player with two or more sales wins the pot."

"----- Whats New with PipDroid v2.0.12 -----
- IMPLEMENTED TUTORIAL SCREEN Due to mass demand, PipDroid now includes a tutorial menu, introducing the APP, presenting new features, and explaining how to navigate and use the APP.
- FACTION REPUTATION MODIFICATION You can now modify your reputation level with all factions inside the APP. Simply press and hold the name of the faction once selected, and watch the reputation level change between the different options.
- MENU CHANGE VARIETY You can now change between different menus in more ways. Simply swiping the top title menu either left or right will switch between the different menus (STATS, ITEMS and DATA) "

" - FULL SCREEN GOODNESS The APP can now be run in true full screen, hiding both the notification bar and the navigation buttons, allowing for a more immersive experience. This new feature can be found in the SETTINGS.
- PERKS AND ITEMS CUSTOMIZATION Perks and ITEMS (Weapons, Apparel, Aid, etc.) can now be customized, such that you can choose from all of the Perks and ITEMS available in the game, and add/show the ones you want, adding an even more personalized experience. The Weapons and Apparel sub-menus also allow "equipping" where you can press and hold the name of an ITEM and "equip" it. The logic of "equipping" follows that of the games, where you can have a weapon and a throwable, or a hat and armour. "

"---------- STATS ----------
----- STATUS ----- Here you can see your character's basic information - Player Name - Player Level - Health - Number of Stimpaks - Etc.
If you press and hold a health container for 1 second or longer, it will hurt your character. Get hurt enough and you'll see the typical damage expressions In order to recover health, simply press the Stimpak button and recover damage "

" It's also on this submenu where you can find the RAD and EFF menus, where you can see your current RAD levels and status effects.
----- S.P.E.C.I.A.L. ----- Here you can find all of the classic S.P.E.C.I.A.L. values from the games.
These values can be edited. Simply select a S.P.E.C.I.A.L. item, press and hold the name of the item, and watch the value increase and decrease. The values you modify will be saved in the APP, so that your character will always have the values you configure. "

" ----- SKILLS ----- Here you can find the SKILLS from both Fallout 3 and Fallout New Vegas.
These values can be edited. Just like the S.P.E.C.I.A.L. values, simply press and hold the name of a SKILL, and watch the value increase and decrease. The longer you press and hold the item, the faster the value will increase.
----- PERKS ----- Here you can find some of the PERKS from the games.
PERKS are now configurable, such that each player can set their own PERKS from a vast list of PERKS from the games. To select the PERKS, simply press and hold the PERKS sub-menu button until the Filter menu pops-up. You can then search for specific PERK names, SELECT ALL or CLEAR ALL, and save. Once you close the Filter, the new PERKS will show up dynamically.
----- GENERAL ----- Here you can find the factions from the games.
These values can be edited. Once you select a faction, you will see their icon, and your reputation with that faction. Press and hold a faction name for the reputation to change from the different options (Idolized, Liked, Accepted, Neutral, Shunned, Hated, Vilified) "
" It is here too where you can find the SETTINGS menu, to change between the different MENUs (STATS, ITEMS, DATA)"

"---------- ITEMS ----------
----- WEAPONS, APPAREL, AID, MISC, AMMO ----- Here you can find some of the classic items from the games.
Currently, these entries are static, and are just for show.
ITEMS are now configurable, such that each player can set their own Weapons, Apparel, Aid, Misc and Ammo from a vast list of ITEMS from the games. To select the ITEMS, simply press and hold the corresponding sub-menu button (Weapons, Apparel, Aid, etc.) until the Filter menu pops-up. You can then search for specific Weapons, Apparel, etc. names, SELECT ALL or CLEAR ALL, and save. Once you close the Filter, the new ITEMS will show up dynamically. "

" The Weapons and Apparel sub-menus also allow "equipping" where you can press and hold the name of an ITEM and "equip" it. The logic of "equipping" follows that of the games, where you can have a weapon and a throwable, or a hat and armour. "

"---------- DATA ----------
----- LOCAL MAP ----- On this menu, you can find a map of the earth.
** Stay tuned for future updates, where there will be little easter eggs added to different key points on the map.
----- WORLD MAP ----- Here you can find the World Maps from both Fallout 3 and Fallout New Vegas.
Featuring all key locations from both games, you can zoom in and see both key location icons and names.
----- QUESTS ----- Here you can find some of the key quests from the games.
** Stay tuned for future updates, where even more quests will be added, and will be editable for you to choose which quest to work on / are pending or not.
----- MISC ----- Here you can find some of the Notes and Holotapes from around the Wasteland.
** Stay tuned for future updates, where even more Notes and Holotapes will be added, and special Holotapes will be implemented.
----- RADIO ----- On this menu you can find music from some of the radio stations from the Wasteland.
You can also choose to listen to your own local music from inside the APP. There is also an option to use PipDroid as a Bed-side clock, using the Clock menu."

"---------- SETTINGS ----------
----- PLAYER NAME ----- Set your players name (16 character limit)
----- PLAYER LEVEL ----- Set your players level (3 digit limit)
----- C. RADIO MP3 FOLDER ----- In order to use the Custom radio, you must choose a folder on your phone where your MP3 files are saved. On Android phones, this is typically 'Music' (Internally saved as '/storage/0/Music'). If you had all your MP3 files in your Downloads folder for example, this value could be 'Download'
----- SCREEN RESIZE ----- For those of you who wish to use this APP with the PipBoy 3000 from The Fallout 4 Special Edition, you can use this option to set the size of the interface to fit inside of the screen Once you have selected this option, you can choose the resize button to enter editing mode and adjust both size (pinching action) and location (single finger moving). Simply press the resize button again to exit editing mode. "

" ----- WORLD MAP SCALING ----- Due to every phone having different screen sizes and resolutions sometimes the world map icons don't show up in the correct locations. To fix this, we've added a simple scaling value just simply modify this value until the locations appear in the correct spots. The following are some example values:
- Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra (Resolution 2316x1080) --- 0.9347
- Samsung Galaxy J3(6) (Resolution 1280x720) --- 0.663
- Blackberry Passport (Resolution 1440x1440) --- 1.0
----- DATE FORMATS ----- You can modify the Date format shown on the DATA menus from the different options available.
- MM/DD/YY - MM/DD/YYYY - DD/MM/YY - DD/MM/YYYY - YYYY/MM/DD
----- UI COLOUR ----- Here you can change the interface colour from different options available in the games.
** Stay tuned for future updates, where a Custom/modifiable colour will be available
----- ENABLE TRUE FULLSCREEN ----- This option hides both the notification bar and the navegation buttons, allowing for a more immersive / fullscreen experience.
----- SHOW TUTORIAL AT START ----- This checkbox indicates whether this tutorial should be shown when the APP is loaded or not.
----- BLUETOOTH SETUP ----- Here you can configure external devices to connect with PipDroid using Bluetooth (ESP32 S3 mini board for example).
For this, you must first configure: - MAC Address of the Bluetooth device - Service UUID - Read UUID - Write UUID
** These values can be found connecting your bluetooth device with a Bluetooth terminal APP
For more information, check out PipDroid's theRPF post '[PipDroid] Functional Pip-Boy 3000 APK' "
